description: This file defines a React Error Boundary component to catch runtime errors in React component trees. It manages error state, logs errors, and conditionally renders fallback UI when an error occurs.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that catches JavaScript errors anywhere in its child component tree, logs those errors, and displays a fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component with empty error state.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method that updates state to display fallback UI when an error occurs.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Logs error information to the console when an error is caught.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the fallback UI with error message or the children components if no error.
